title: Angles: Types, Lines and Triangles
seo_title: Angles – JSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Identify types of angles; find angles on a straight line, at a point and vertically opposite angles; use the angle sum of triangles and quadrilaterals. (summary of the NERDC JSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 1 maths worksheets on angles: angles on a straight line, angles at a point, vertically opposite angles, angles in triangles and quadrilaterals. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Acute < 90°, right = 90°, obtuse between 90° and 180°, reflex between 180° and 360°.
  • Angles on a straight line add up to 180°; angles at a point add up to 360°; vertically opposite angles are equal.
  • Angles in a triangle add up to 180°; in a quadrilateral, 360°.

Examples

Example

Angles 3x and 2x on a straight line

5x = 180

Answer: x = 36°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using 360° for a straight lineA straight line is 180°.
Adding vertically opposite anglesThey are equal.
Forgetting the right-angle markA square corner is 90°.
